modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal: Good morning, everyone and Happy Friday. It is finally here, and now I have 4 days off, or at least I hope so 😁 Here is another Kling 4.0 video. I shared the prompt I used for it below 😉 https://t.co/Ey6zmgAoOp

originalPrompt: A human traveler walks through a crowded alien marketplace filled with species of different shapes and sizes. A six-limbed merchant unfolds colorful fabrics, a robotic vendor prepares food and small creatures scurry between the stalls. The camera weaves through the moving crowd, cinematic space opera, rich realistic detail.
